name: cells
description: Lets Claude make several edits and their check, or a language-server lookup or rename, in one step through the real tools; guidance on chaining, which a subagent's task carries too; and a short note when a step cost a model request of its own for nothing.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Turn this mod off or on; /mods does it for all of the pack.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: cells: the run_cell tool, the chaining guidance and the notes. nudge: the guidance and the notes only. off: nothing.

visuals.title: Draw cells as cards
visuals.description: Draw each cell as a card with its program, one row per call and its state.

nudges.title: Point out avoidable requests
nudges.description: After a model request that did no more than a step needing no judgment (a check right after edits, one more single edit, the same command again) or a script that rewrote files around the Edit tool, add a short note on how to save it. Never blocks.

autoModeLine.title: A line in auto mode's note
autoModeLine.description: Auto mode tells Claude to make small file changes with sed, heredocs or short scripts. Add one line to that note: several edits and their check go through run_cell, by the Edit tool, so each diff shows and /rewind can restore it, and a single small mechanical change by the shell. Main session only.

subagents.title: Subagents too
subagents.description: A subagent Claude starts gets the chaining guidance with its task, in your name: it has a system prompt of its own, which the guidance never reaches. Not a fork (it has the guidance already), a teammate, or delegate's worker.
